inference_before_unblinding: No universal merge winner. Six Sully candidates retain the coarse reference-like design but omit the vest; C08 retains vest/palette with altered face/horn depiction, while C10/C15 deviate more substantially. Most Series30 candidates attain a lowered-glove ending, but C17 remains in guard and C01/C18 lower late. Repeated or separated action bursts do not certify exactly two punches. Similarity, identity, clothing, exact action count, ending and sound remain separate dimensions; no automatic ranking change is justified by sparse visual observations alone.
